      "rationale": "The crew was preparing the boundary (condition) when RHOB reported an air-low indication and requested attendance. Utilities acknowledged receipt at ~10:02 AM, which directly caused them to pause work.",

      "sourceIds": ["n-2jjl7x#1","n-wzbnxb#1","n-1qy43nt#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If RHOB had not reported the indication or requested attendance, Utilities would likely have continued work at 09:48–10:02.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; timing aligns with shift log entries and acknowledgment record.",
      "evidenceGap": "The exact cause of the air-low indication (source vs. distribution) remains unknown, but it is sufficient to explain the pause."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1qy43nt",
      "toKey": "n-8pkzru",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Utilities paused work after acknowledging receipt of an air-low indication. This pause was a direct response to the event, but does not explain what caused the original pressure drop.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["n-1qy43nt#1","n-8pkzru#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If no air-low indication occurred, Utilities would not have paused work at 10:02.",
      "competingExplanation": "Alternative causes for the pressure drop (e.g., upstream outage vs. local valve) remain unknown; evidence does not distinguish them yet.",
      "evidenceGap": "Need to determine whether P-R dropped due to a supply interruption, distribution leak, or equipment failure."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1qy43nt",
      "toKey": "n-1k72jwr",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The air-low indication at RHOB prompted Utilities to pause work. This event may have been preceded by a missing or unrecorded P-R reading, but evidence does not confirm whether such a reading existed.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["n-1qy43nt#1","n-1k72jwr#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If P-R had been recorded at 09:45 and showed normal pressure, the drop would have been unexpected; if not recorded, baseline is unknown.",
      "competingExplanation": "The absence of a record does not prove no reading was taken; it only means evidence is missing to confirm or deny one.",
      "evidenceGap": "Need access to shift logs or sensor data covering 09:45–10:00 to verify whether P-R readings were captured."
    }
  ],
  "decision": {
    "summary": "The investigation board currently links the air-low indication (n-8pkzru) and subsequent work pause (n-1qy43nt), but cannot yet explain what caused the pressure drop. The causal chain is incomplete because the origin of the interruption remains unknown.",

      "If any service-routing change occurred between March and May 20, 2024"
    ],
    "alternatives": [
      "Upstream supply failure (e.g., header outage)",
      "Distribution system leak or valve mispositioned downstream of P-R",
      "Local equipment fault at RHOB receiving station H-R"
    ],"confidence": 0.65},"evidenceRequests":[
    "requestId\":\"req-1\",\"sourceId\":\"24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1\",\"claimRef\":\"n-1k72jwr\",\"question\":\"Was a P-R pressure reading recorded at 09:45 AM? If so, what was its value and status (normal band or otherwise)?","rationale\":\"Establishing whether the baseline before the drop was normal would help determine if this was an unexpected event.","evidenceGap\":\"Current evidence only shows samples starting at 09:54; earlier data is missing."
